name: Ants: Leaf-al Warfare
detailed_description: Ants: Leaf-Al Warfare is a 2D turn based strategy game where you fight other players with their own Ant armies in a turf war. You command your army of Ants and move yourself into tactical positions and select various weapons to take down your opponents. Heading your army is a Queen Ant, who has a special ability unique to each army that can be used to turn the tides in battle. Clever use of your Queen’s abilities is the key to win this game. Losing your Queen will cause your surviving Ants to lose extra health, and you will no longer be able to use your Queen’s ability. You’re not just fighting the enemy teams however, as you’ve also got the environmental hazards lying in wait for you! Whether it be a Venus Flytrap or an unsecured Barbecue, the environment will be just as much a player as you are! The unpredictable combat and toon styled visuals will give you a thrill when you send another Ant launching across the battlefield and into the Pond or even throwing a grenade into a Plant Pot and watching the unlucky adversaries within. With combat like this, war has never been so Leaf-al!

short_description: Ants: Leaf-Al Warfare is a 2D turn based strategy game where you must command your army of Ants, headed by a Queen, against up to three other foes, being wary of the various environmental hazards. Putting your tactical prowess to good use is the key to victory. War has never been so Leaf-al.
